attributions.quote: Out of my longs, tough day today, 4 SLs back to back, rn at -3R.
attributions.reasoning: This single event reports FOUR stop-outs at once, so no one symbol fits the `attributed_symbol` slot. Reconstructing the book from the log: at 2026-06-03 01:56 the longs still open and never otherwise closed were exactly four - BTCUSDT (msg 331 call @69.3k / msg 332 entry 69.4k, SL 66.5k), BNBUSDT (msg 317 call 680 / msg 319 entry, SL 652, runner still live after partials at msg 326 and msg 330 'I'll keep BNB running, till SL or TP'), FETUSDT (msg 328 call 0.276, SL 0.249) and SEIUSDT (msg 333 call 0.067, hard SL 0.0627 at msg 338). All four go completely silent from msg 341 onward - none is ever reported TP'd, closed or mentioned again in June - and he re-opens a brand new BTC long at 67.3k eight hours later (msg 343), consistent with the 69.4k long being gone. NEARUSDT was also open but was NOT stopped: msg 342 (06-03 09:11) shows his own Blofin card, NEAR 75x entry 2.643 at +574% open, and it TP'd at msg 347 - so 'Out of my longs' is loose/hyperbolic. SOLUSDT stopped earlier and was already booked separately at msg 335 (06-02 17:50, 'The month just started, 3 TPs (XPL, RAY, BNB), 1 SL (SOL) so far'), which is why it is listed as an alternative rather than one of the four. ETHUSDT (msg 296-302) had its SL at breakeven, so a stop there would be a BE not a loss; it is the other alternative. The -3R total for four stops (rather than -4R) fits this set: BNB had already banked ~1.2R of partials and SEI was near breakeven (msg 337 'I think we can easily get BE').

attributions.quote:
Another SL, bad day

I'm the most bullish guy here and I'm getting fked in shorts, no more shorting before white house summit
attributions.reasoning: Three shorts were open on 2026-08-19: BTCUSDT (msg 960 entry 64.2k, DCA'd to 64.3k avg at msg 965, hard SL 65.8k per msg 972), ZECUSDT (msg 964 entry 505.2, SL 517.5) and HYPEUSDT (msg 974 at 18:05:47, entry 59.82, DCA'd @60.5 at msg 976 18:38:59, hard SL 61.5). Fifteen minutes after this message he posts msg 978 'we had ... 3 SLs' - so all three shorts stopped that day and this message is the last of the three ('Another SL'). The first two are already accounted for earlier in the evening: msg 971 (17:24) 'BTC and ZEC almost missed TP twice and pumped hard' and msg 973 (18:02, posted as a reply in the BTC short thread) 'Just got greedy with the short ... not a great feeling rn' read as the BTC/ZEC post-mortems. That leaves HYPE, and the timing is decisive: this message lands 2m29s after the HYPE DCA at 60.5 with the hard SL only 1.65% away at 61.5, and HYPE was in a vertical squeeze that evening - msg 981 at 22:37 shows his HYPE spot at +27.77% on a 56.23 average (~71.8 mark), i.e. HYPE ran roughly 60.5 -> 72 within four hours. The HYPE short is never mentioned again after msg 976, never closed and never TP'd. 'no more shorting before white house summit' also reads as a reaction to a short opened 35 minutes earlier blowing up. Not stated outright, hence medium rather than high.

attributions.quote: Not available on BLOFIN so just cancelled
attributions.reasoning: OUT-OF-SCOPE TYPE (event_type is 'update', not one of the listed trade-action types) but it is a trade action in substance - an order cancellation - so it is recorded here. The symbol cannot be settled. Immediate context is BTCUSDT (msg 600-603 long from 58.2k, all closed at 59.1k three minutes earlier; msg 605 '60k hit' three minutes later) and BTC is obviously listed on Blofin, so it is not BTC. The only non-BTC instrument live in the window is TOSHIUSDT (msg 593, 06-25 15:12, 'Long TOSHI ... Shitcoin, total gambling'), which would be the natural 'not on Blofin' candidate - except he is demonstrably still in TOSHI afterwards (msg 613 'TOSHI running!', msg 617-619 with a 50x TOSHIUSDT card at +965%), so the cancelled order is not the TOSHI position either. No other instrument is named anywhere near this message. Left null.

education_and_rules.topic: how to use a position-size calculator
education_and_rules.lesson: Five-step walkthrough: wallet, risk %, entry and SL -> position size, then enter that size manually on the exchange. Demonstrated with the SUI trade at 1% risk, entry 1, SL 0.95.
education_and_rules.quote: How to use it? Step1: Write your wallet Step2: Write your risk % Step3: Write your Entry SL Step4: It gives you a position size, how much coins or margin to long Step5: Go to your exchange manually write down the coins or margin

education_and_rules.lesson: Set the order 'by amount' on the exchange; he demonstrates on Blofin but says every exchange has the same setting.
education_and_rules.quote: Go to your exchanges and set by amount I'm doing this on blofin but every exchange has it the same.

education_and_rules.lesson: If position size is fixed by the calculator, the leverage used is irrelevant to risk - even 500x is fine as long as the same amount is written down.
education_and_rules.quote: A bit if educational posts, simplest way to risk management it can't get any easier. If you use this way you don't have to worry how much leverage to use, you can use even 500x as long as you're writing down the same amount!
